params.name: project_identifier
params.description: The project identifier: either project ID or project name. If using a project name, it cannot contain slash (/), question mark (?), or pound sign (#) characters.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor (Span Global ID)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of spans to return

params.name: start_time
params.description: Inclusive lower bound time

params.name: end_time
params.description: Exclusive upper bound time

params.name: trace_id
params.description: Filter by one or more trace IDs

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Filter by parent span ID. Use "null" to get root spans only.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by span name(s)

params.name: status_code
params.description: Filter by status code(s). Values: OK, ERROR, UNSET

params.name: attribute
params.description: Filter spans by `key:value`. Key is a dot-path (e.g. `user.id`, `metadata.tier`). Value is JSON-parsed: `k:12345` is int, `k:true` is bool, otherwise string (`k:user-42`). To match a numeric- or boolean-looking STRING, JSON-quote it: `user.id:"12345"` (URL-encoded `%2212345%22`). Split is on the first `:` only, so values may contain colons (`session.id:sess:abc:123`, ISO timestamps). Repeat the param to AND filters. List-valued attributes (e.g. `tag.tags`) cannot be matched here. Returns 422 on malformed input (missing colon, empty key/value, or list/dict/null value).

items.docs: Return spans within a project filtered by time range. Supports cursor-based pagination.

items.docs: Add a note annotation to a span. By default each call appends a new note with an auto-generated UUIDv4 identifier, so multiple notes accumulate on the same span. Callers may supply a non-empty `identifier` to upsert on (span_id, name='note', identifier) — repeated calls with the same identifier overwrite the existing note, matching the semantics of structured annotations.
